findings: Short exact business and founder excerpts retain their complete original parent source in details and export appendix.

Income and customer plans retain explicit entity, reporting window, equal follow-up, source records, cost presentation and missing-input conditions.
The founder offer requests accounting, cost and customer records and proposes contribution/cohort tables; it asserts neither completed work nor verified performance.

limits: Eligibility and the enrollment event need company-record definitions; define the eligible registration population before measuring plan enrollment.

No company accounts were independently verified, no real financial result was calculated, and no independent practitioner acceptance occurred.
